I wrote the program in `src/main.zig` plus a `build.sh` that builds an optimized binary at `./app`. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases, and the unit test (`zig test src/main.zig`) passes.

- **How it works:** It reads stdin in 64 KB chunks rather than loading all of it at once. A word that crosses the boundary between two chunks is held over and counted correctly. It counts in a hash map and keeps a running top 10, so the full word list is never sorted.
